transcript.en: Jack, I'm thinking of taking the kids to the seaside on a surfing holiday this summer and I wanted to ask your advice- as I know you’re such an expert.
transcript.zh: Jack，我想今年夏天带孩子们去海边冲浪度假，我想问问你的建议——因为我知道你是个专家。

transcript.en: Well, I don't know about that, but yes, I've done a bit of surfing over the years.
transcript.zh: 嗯，这个我不知道，但是是的，这些年来我做过一些冲浪。

transcript.en: I'd thoroughly recommend it. I think it's the kind of holiday all the family can enjoy together.
transcript.zh: 我完全推荐。我认为这是全家人可以一起享受的假期。

transcript.en: The thing about surfing is that it's great for all ages and all abilities. My youngest started when he was only three!
transcript.zh: 冲浪的好处是它适合所有年龄和所有能力的人。我最小的孩子在他三岁的时候就开始了！

transcript.en: Wow! But it's quite physically demanding, isn't it?I've heard you need to be pretty fit.
transcript.zh: 哇！但这对体力要求很高，不是吗？我听说你需要非常健康。

transcript.en: Yes. You'll certainly learn more quickly and won't tire as easily.
transcript.zh: 是的。你肯定会学得更快，也不会那么容易疲倦。

transcript.en: Well - that should be OK for us.
transcript.zh: 嗯——这对我们来说应该没问题。

transcript.en: You've been surfing a few times in Ireland,haven't you?
transcript.zh: 你已经在爱尔兰冲过几次浪了，不是吗？

transcript.en: Yes. There's some great surfing there, which people don't always realise.
transcript.zh: 是的。那里有一些很棒的冲浪运动，是人们一直没有意识到的。

transcript.en: And which locations would you recommend? -there seem to be quite a few.
transcript.zh: 那你会推荐哪些地方？——似乎有不少。

transcript.en: Yes, there are loads. Last year we went to County Donegal. There are several great places to surf there.
transcript.zh: 是的，有很多。去年我们去了多尼戈尔郡。那里有几个很棒的冲浪场所。

transcript.en: What about in County Clare? I read that's also really good for surfing.
transcript.zh: 克莱尔郡呢？我读到过那里也非常适合冲浪。

transcript.en: Yes, it is. I've been there a few times. Most people go to Lahinch.
transcript.zh: 是的。我去过那里几次。大多数人去拉欣奇。

transcript.en: My kids love it there. The waves aren't too challenging and the town is very lively.
transcript.zh: 我的孩子们喜欢那里。海浪并不太具挑战性，小镇也非常热闹。

transcript.en: Are there good hotels there?
transcript.zh: 那里有好旅馆吗？

transcript.en: Yes ,some very nice ones and there are also a few basic hostels and campsites.
transcript.zh: 是的 - 有一些旅馆非常不错，还有一些基本的旅社和露营地。

transcript.en: It's great if you need lessons as the surf schools are excellent.
transcript.zh: 如果您需要课程，那就太好了，因为冲浪学校非常棒。

transcript.en: Sounds good.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: Yes and there's lots to see in the area - like those well-known cliffs-I've forgotten the name of them ...
transcript.zh: 是的，该地区有很多值得一看的地方——比如那些著名的悬崖——……我忘记了它们的名字……

transcript.en: Oh don't worry - I can look them up
transcript.zh: 哦，别担心——我能查到的。

transcript.en: I've also been surfing in County Mayo, which is less well-known for surfing,?
transcript.zh: 我也在梅奥郡冲浪过，那里的冲浪不太出名，

transcript.en: but we had a really good time. That was a few years ago when the kids were younger. There's a good surf school at Carrowniskey beach.
transcript.zh: 但我们玩得很开心。那是在几年前孩子们还小的时候。Carrowniskey海滩有一所很好的冲浪学校。

transcript.en: How do you spell that?
transcript.zh: 怎么拼写？

transcript.en: C-A-double R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y
transcript.zh: C-A-双R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: I put the kids into the surf camp they run during the summer for 10 -16 year olds.
transcript.zh: 我让孩子们参加了为10-16岁孩子举办的夏天冲浪营。

transcript.en: Oh right. How long was that for?
transcript.zh: 哦，对了。那是多久？

transcript.en: Three hours every day for a week. It was perfect -they were so tired out after that.
transcript.zh: 为期一周，每天三个小时。这是完美的——再多他们就太累了。

transcript.en: I can imagine.
transcript.zh: 我能想象。

transcript.en: One thing we did while the kids were surfing was to rent some kayaks to have a look around the bay which is nearby.
transcript.zh: 我们在孩子们冲浪的时候做的一件事就是租了一些皮划艇去看看附近的海湾，

transcript.en: It's really beautiful.
transcript.zh: 真的很漂亮。

transcript.en: Oh, I'd love to do that.
transcript.zh: 哦，我很想这样做。

transcript.en: Now the only time I went to Ireland it rained practically every day.
transcript.zh: 现在我唯一一次去爱尔兰，几乎每天都在下雨。

transcript.en: Mmm yes -that can be a problem - but you can surf in the rain, you know.
transcript.zh: 嗯，是的——这可能是个问题——但你可以在雨中冲浪，你知道的。

transcript.en: It doesn't have the same appeal, somehow.
transcript.zh: 不知何故，它没有同样的吸引力。

transcript.en: Well, the weather's been fine the last couple of years when I've been there,but actually, it tends to rain more in August than in the spring or autumn.
transcript.zh: 嗯，过去几年我去那里的时候天气很好，但实际上，八月的雨往往比春季或秋季多。

transcript.en: September's my favourite month because the water is warmer then.
transcript.zh: 九月是我最喜欢的月份，因为那时水更暖和。

transcript.en: The only problem is that the kids are back to school then.
transcript.zh: 唯一的问题是那时候孩子们已经回学校了。

transcript.en: I know. But one good thing about Irish summers is that it doesn't get too hot.
transcript.zh: 我知道。但爱尔兰夏天的一件好事是它不会变得太热。

transcript.en: The average temperature is about 19 degrees and it usually doesn't go above 25 degrees.
transcript.zh: 平均温度约为19度，通常不会超过25度。

transcript.en: That sounds alright. Now what about costs?
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。花费是多少呢？

transcript.en: Surfing is a pretty cheap holiday really -he only cost is the hire of equipment.
transcript.zh: 冲浪真的是一个非常便宜的假期 - 唯一的花费就是租用设备。

transcript.en: You can expect to pay a daily rate of about 30 euros for the hire of a wetsuit and board
transcript.zh: 您可以预计每天支付约30欧元的费用来租用潜水服和冲浪板 -

transcript.en: but you can save about 40 euros if you hire by the week.
transcript.zh: 但如果按周租用，则可以节省约40欧元。

transcript.en: That's not too bad.
transcript.zh: 那还不错。

transcript.en: No. It's important to make sure you get good quality wetsuits you'll all get too cold if you don't.
transcript.zh: 不，确保你得到优质的潜水服很重要——如果没有，你会特别冷。

transcript.en: And make sure you also get boots. They keep your feet warm and it's easier to surf with them on too.
transcript.zh: 同时也得确保你能得到靴子，它们能使您的双脚保持温暖，穿着它们冲浪也会更容易。

transcript.en: OK. Well, thanks very much ...
transcript.zh: 好的，非常感谢……
